description: This Python source file defines a set of API routes for managing user sessions in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting sessions, leveraging a Supabase backend for data storage and handling user authentication. The file uses dependency injection for current user retrieval and encapsulates database interactions with Supabase client calls.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client configured with URL and key from environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(request: Request, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all sessions for the authenticated user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: create_session(request: Request, payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new session record for the current user based on provided data.

methods.name: get_session(request: Request, session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific session by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_session(request: Request, session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing session if provided.

methods.name: delete_session(request: Request, session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a session identified by ID, restricted to current user's sessions.
